svg.style: display: block; width: min(100%, 39rem); height: auto; margin: 1.5rem auto;
svg.title: Batch runs the feedback program for each example
svg.desc: Batch transforms the feedback program into one batched IR. Stacked program rectangles represent the batch dimension. The rubric, scale, and loss seed are shared; each example and target vary. Each batch item returns its own loss and feedback.
